text: I'm sorry to bother you at this hour, I'm minding my grandson who is 8 while his parents are away and I've been up most of the night with him. He's had a temperature, it was 37.9 when I last took it, so not that high I don't think. But about an hour ago he had what I can only describe as a fit. He went stiff and his arms and legs were shaking and his eyes went up. He's never had anything like that before, not once, and it frightened the life out of me. On top of that he keeps saying the light hurts his eyes, he's had his hands over his face and asked me to turn the big light off, even the hallway light was bothering him. I'm absolutely shattered and I don't want to get this wrong, I just need to know what I should be doing.
